messages:
matt: Quick FYI — I'm going to sweep and merge a chain of dependent PRs across SDK -> API -> Console -> Helm. Need a quick compat check and approvals.

sarah: thanks — can you list PR numbers and blockers?

matt: sure: SDK (#7442) updates client auth header + bumps api contract. API (#3321) has the contract change and a minor schema rename. Console (#1588) needs the new header and UI prop change. Helm (#204) updates chart values for new env var. Ordering matters: SDK -> API -> Console -> Helm.

nate: @matt can we gate API merge on runtime test pass? runtime team flagged KV cache change earlier.

matt: yes — planning to run integration against staging runtime. if any kernel mismatch, we hold. @lina can you run the smoke batch on staging runtime after API merge?

lina: yep. I'll run `./scripts/run-smoke.sh --target=staging` and report. ETA 30m post-merge.

matt: commands I'm using:
```
# local validation
make fmt test
./scripts/validate-contract.sh api proto v2
# merge SDK then API
gh pr merge 7442 --admin
gh pr merge 3321 --admin --squash
```

sarah: who are reviewers needed? I can take SDK and console quick review.

matt: reviewers: SDK — @sarah, @chris. API — @nate, @lina. Console — @sarah. Helm — @ops (or ops-core).

chris: SDK code looks fine but there's one lint nits. I'll post a tiny fix. not a blocker.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] API staging deploy queued for 2165433000 by matt :rocket:

anna: note — update changelog entries and add compatibility note in release notes. small PR for docs OK.

matt: good call @anna. I'll open docs PR after merges.

nate: after API merge i'll run:
```
./tools/runtime-compat-check --endpoint staging --model-length 1024
```
If it fails we revert API and notify.

lina: smoke pass succeeded: basic batching + kv cache checks ok. no regressions on staging runtime.

matt: excellent. going to merge SDK now. pinging reviewers for final approvals. ETA 15m.

sarah: approved SDK, lgtm :+1:

chris: approved after nits fixed :white_check_mark:

matt: SDK merged. Kicking API merge now.

sarah: quick reminder — leave console PR in draft until API is merged and migrated config toggles on.

matt: will do.

lina: runtime compatibility check passed after API merge. no perf dips.

matt: merging console then helm. tagging ops for final helm values. @ops please watch for canary.

deploy-bot: helm canary deploy started for release redwood-2165-canary at 2165433500

ops: watching. will advise if canary fails.

matt: thanks all — post-merge notes: expect a minor client bump for SDK consumers. I'll send a short announcement and link to upgrade guide.

sarah: thanks — if anyone sees production alerts across model-serving routes ping #eng-oncall.

matt: done. closing thread once docs PR is up. :v:
